$comment: Renderer hints for stalls (Renderer owns). Sign/tag text is MTSDF Fredoka (stalls/fonts, BMFont JSON + RGBA PNG; RGB median = MSDF, A = true SDF) drawn at attach points (x/y = box CENTRE); auto-shrink to fit box then ellipsis.

sign.fit: 1 line shrink to minSizePx 6; else word-wrap 2 lines shrink to 5; else ellipsis
sign.source: StallSign.name (nameLen u8, name u8[24], printable ASCII)

worldPrompt.drivenBy: StallHeader.open + StallSign.soldOut (both on the stock entity)
worldPrompt.$anchor: Place the prompt/badge sprite ANCHOR at the stall attach "badge" (pivot-relative, centred, 2px above the topmost art row of the trimmed frame; per-rotation via frameAttach). Badge anchors are their body bottom (y 0.84375), prompt anchor is its pointer tip (0.9). Do not use anchorY*0.8.

sway.note: sway masks are per-atlas pages (masks.sway); awnings/bunting/banners/drapes weight 255, closed curtains ~90

attach.tags: tagN = centre of the stall_price_tag text box (14x6). Nothing is baked: draw stall_price_tag at tagN - sprite.attach.text (1.5,-9) only for enabled listings.
